description: Priority 1 - Push Notifications: Add investigation logging to backend push-token endpoint. The controller already has one log line, but needs additional logging to confirm: (1) when the endpoint is HIT, (2) what token was received, and (3) whether MongoDB write succeeds or fails. Also add success/failure logging in the service layer.
steps: In backend/src/modules/users/user.controller.js registerPushToken function: Add a console.log at the VERY TOP of the try block (before validation) that prints '[PushToken] POST /users/me/push-token HIT by userId: <req.user.id>, body: <JSON.stringify(req.body)>'. This tells us the request reached the server.
After the existing log line that shows the truncated token, add a log showing the FULL token: console.log('[PushToken] Full token received:', token)

Wrap the userService.registerPushToken call in a try/catch and log success: console.log('[PushToken] MongoDB write SUCCESS for userId:', req.user.id) or failure: console.error('[PushToken] MongoDB write FAILED for userId:', req.user.id, 'error:', err.message)

In backend/src/modules/users/user.service.js registerPushToken function: After the findByIdAndUpdate call, add console.log('[PushToken] DB $addToSet completed for userId:', userId) to confirm the DB operation completed
Commit with message: 'fix(backend): add investigation logging to push-token registration endpoint'
acceptance_criteria: The registerPushToken controller logs when endpoint is hit (before any validation)
The registerPushToken controller logs the full token value
The registerPushToken controller logs whether the MongoDB write succeeded or failed
The registerPushToken service logs when DB operation completes
findings: Git object corruption required re-cloning the repository. NODE_OPTIONS env var needed to be cleared for node --check due to sandbox preload issue.
